'''R4-H5''' was an [[R4-P astromech droid]] used by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] in his [[Kit Fisto's Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor|Delta-7 Jedi starfighter]]. R4-H5 had a dome painted a red-orange with a body that was green and yellow-green in color.

==History==
R4-H5 served as Kit Fisto's Astromech droid during the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]].

==Behind the scenes==
R4-H5 lacks the R4-series's trademark conical head dome, similar to [[R4-P17/Legends|R4-P17]], the droid used by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] in his Delta-7. The Jedi modified many of their R4 units to have [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2 series]] domes.

Coincidentally enough, R4-H5 shares the "H5" with Kit Fisto's other droid, [[R6-H5/Legends|R6-H5]].

In 2008 Hasbro made a figure of R4-H5 as part of their Build-a-Droid series, offered exclusive to Wal-Mart.
